jcr:title: Stryker is a Gallup Great Workplace for the 11th year

text.text:
For the 11th year, Stryker received the prestigious Gallup Great Workplace Award. This award recognizes organizations for their extraordinary ability to create engaged workplace cultures that drive business outcomes.

According to Gallup, companies with this winning combination have a competitive edge—organizations with highly engaged workforces can outperform their peers by 147% in earnings per share. Only 61 companies were eligible to apply.

This year, Gallup honored 39 organizations from across the globe, representing a range of different industries. Gallup reviewed employee responses to their annual employee engagement survey (Q12) and each company’s response rate when determining the list. In addition, a panel of Gallup workplace experts evaluated applicants and assessed them against criteria established by a comprehensive workplace study. The top organizations had an average engagement ratio of 14:1.

To learn more about Gallup, check out their web site: http://www.gallup.com/events/178865/gallup-great-workplace-award-current-previous-winners.aspx
